message.text: Taken: one Sonnet minion is finding what triggers the reloads on the card page. It's also making a reload wait until the mic is idle and then happen once, so the mic isn't cut off mid-sentence. I'll report when it lands.

Landed, live on the main tree. The page reloaded because the dev server tells every tab to reload when a file it loaded changes, and other agents edit the ai2 files and Socket.js often, so a reload could cut off the mic. Now the mic (in compose.js) tells the reload code in Socket.js when it is busy, and a reload that arrives meanwhile waits, checks once a second, and reloads once when the mic is idle. The reload will be held while you dictate and happen right after.
